## Shared problem and benefit

What reusable bug, capability or documentation gap does this solve?
If this only adds machine-specific constants or a success report, please use a
compatibility issue/local profile first. See the
[contribution policy](https://github.com/impacifist/Windows-GPU-UNLOCK/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTION-POLICY.en.md).

## Scope and dependencies

List prerequisite PRs. Separate shared code from machine-specific data, research
notes and operational tools. Explain any requested fixed-profile exception.
Disclose downloads, privileged operations, hardware writes and bundled binaries,
if any, with their source/license information.

## Validation and limits

List the checks actually run, their results and what remains untested. Distinguish
host/synthetic checks from hardware observations. Existing hardware evidence should
identify its source/build and relevant test conditions; do not run a new EFI or
workload merely to open this PR. Explain how existing guards/failure paths remain intact.
